newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Only one set of coalition talks this week-NZ First.
newsitem.headline: Only one set of coalition talks this week-NZ First.

text.p: The New Zealand First Party, which holds the balance of political power, said on Monday that only one set of formal coalition negotiations would take place this week.
A spokesman said NZ First would meet the negotiating team from the caretaker National Party government at 2 p.m. on Tuesday, and Labour at 5 p.m.
"The rest of the week will be taken up with informal talks," he said.

Coalition talks have been dragging on for four weeks after an inconclusive general election on October 12. New Zealand First refuses to say if it favours a deal with National or the centre-left Labour party.
